材質與加工選型：
· PVC 防水（基礎面材，性價比高，戶外首選）
· PP 合成紙（+10%，紙感較強，適合短期活動）
· 覆膜：光膜（+0）／啞膜（+5%），提升耐磨與抗污
· 異形模切（+30%）：任意形狀，品牌輪廓直接成形
· 強力背膠（如 3M，視稿與材質評估）
規格由約 10×10mm 至 300×400mm，ICC 色彩管理確保品牌色穩定還原，支援可變資料（序號／條碼／QR）。

交稿規範：300 DPI、CMYK 色彩模式、3mm 出血、字體外框化。提交檔案後 1 小時內提供免費數碼打稿，最多免費修改 2 次。未有設計檔案？透過 WhatsApp 提供品牌顏色、Logo 及參考圖片，設計團隊免費打稿。每個標準尺寸提供免費刀模線模板下載。

**常見問題**

**Q1: 防水貼紙真的防水嗎？**
防水。PVC 防水貼紙可淋雨、沖洗與短時間浸泡；覆膜版本可抵受洗碗機 80°C 高溫循環，適合貼在需要經常清洗的容器上。

**Q2: 戶外可以使用多久？**
配合 UV 防褪色油墨，戶外使用 3 年不明顯褪色；室內可達 5 年。長期暴曬位置建議加覆膜。

**Q3: 最小起印量是多少？**
10 張起印，無開版費。小批量系列另有 50 張方案。標準 5-7 個工作天交貨，順豐 1-2 個工作天送達。

**Q4: 可以印可變資料（序號／條碼／QR Code）嗎？**
可以。數碼快印支援每張不同的序號、條碼或 QR Code，適合設備資產標籤與活動票券。

- PP synthetic paper (+10%, paper feel, short-term events)
- Lamination: gloss (+0) / matte (+5%) for abrasion and stain resistance

- Heavy-duty adhesive (e.g. 3M, subject to artwork and stock)

Yes. PVC waterproof stickers handle rain, washing and brief soaking; laminated versions withstand dishwasher cycles up to 80C, ideal for containers that get cleaned often.

With UV-resistant ink, colors stay vivid for 3 years outdoors and up to 5 years indoors. For constant sun exposure we recommend lamination.

10 pcs with no setup fees. A 50-pc small-batch option is available. Standard lead time is 5-7 business days.

Yes. Digital printing supports a different serial, barcode or QR code on every sticker - perfect for asset labels and event tickets.

Printed on transparent PET with an optional white ink base for solid color. 10 pcs MOQ, free US shipping over $99. Best surfaces for clear stickers: perfume and serum glass bottles, craft drink and wine bottles, clear cosmetic jars, candle vessels, no-label packaging for cross-border e-commerce gift boxes. The transparent edge blends into the container itself - a finish white-backed stickers cannot match.

How to choose the white ink base:
- Pure clear effect: CMYK printed directly on transparent PET, colors stay translucent, ideal for light containers
- White ink base (recommended): a white layer under CMYK keeps colors saturated on dark green, amber or cobalt glass
- Free prepress check of reversed text and minimum font sizes

**Q1: Will colors show on a dark bottle?**
Printed directly, colors stay translucent - add a white ink base instead. The white layer keeps colors saturated on dark green, amber or cobalt containers; just note white ink when ordering.

No. The edge is transparent PET - only your artwork and text are visible. For a truly invisible look, avoid large solid color blocks in the design.

Custom security stickers that protect brands and assets: VOID tamper-evident labels leave a VOID message or open-tamper mark when peeled, and destructible paper shreds on removal so re-application is impossible. 10 pcs MOQ with variable serials, QR codes and barcodes for anti-diversion tracking. Free US shipping over $99. ISO 9001 certified production, 15+ years of print experience.

Typical security sticker jobs: warranty seals for electronics and appliances, anti-counterfeit marks on certificates and inspection reports, bottle-neck seals for wine and beauty products, tamper-proof seals for takeout and gift packaging, numbered asset labels. Cross-border sellers and training providers use them for authenticity verification.

Choosing your anti-counterfeit feature:
- VOID tamper-evident: leaves VOID wording on the surface - the standard for warranty and sealing
- Destructible paper: shreds into fragments, cannot be re-applied
- Holographic film: laser hologram raises the bar against fakes
- Variable data: a different serial, QR or barcode per label, tracked in your system
- Batch sample retention and color-delta control for traceable quality
Sizes from tiny seals up to A4 gang sheets, multilingual warning text supported.

File requirements: 300 DPI, CMYK, 3mm bleed, outlined fonts. Free digital proof within 1 hour of file submission. No design files yet? Send your logo and references via WhatsApp - free design mockup. Not sure which feature fits? Ask customer service for a combination recommendation.

Pricing is transparent: 10 pcs MOQ. Anti-counterfeit features are quoted per plan - VOID, destructible paper and holographic film differ in price; customer service replies with a tailored plan within 2 hours. Standard production 5-7 business days. Free shipping to the lower 48 states on orders over $99 with 4-day delivery. Instant online quote in 30 seconds.

**FAQ**

**Q1: How does a VOID tamper-evident sticker work?**
The face stock and adhesive separate on peeling: the label lifts off and leaves VOID wording or a preset pattern on the surface, showing the package has been opened.

**Q2: What is destructible paper?**
An extremely brittle stock that shreds into tiny pieces when lifted, so it cannot be transferred intact onto counterfeits - ideal for certificates and bottle seals.

**Q3: Can every sticker carry a different serial or QR code?**
Yes. Variable-data digital printing gives each label a unique serial, QR or barcode; connect it to your system to verify authenticity and track diversion.

**Q4: What is the smallest security sticker size?**
Tiny seals of a few millimeters are possible; common sizes run 20x20mm up to A4 gang sheets, depending on placement and artwork.
